summary.motive: Run outside the tackles behind two pulling guards so the defense's edge structure collapses inward and the perimeter belongs to the offense.
summary.whyItWorks: The double pull forces every defender to re-fit mid-play; the kick-out removes force and the lead block plus downfield escorts guarantee one clean running lane.
summary.failureMode: The force defender beats the kick-out block outside, or the backside pursuit angles close the lane before the escorts arrive.

beats.title: 1. The Double Pull Begins
beats.text: Both guards pull simultaneously — the first leads through the lane while the second wraps to kick out the force player. The defense sees pulling linemen and must re-route its fits instantly.

beats.title: 2. The Deep Handoff
beats.text: The quarterback extends the ball at full depth so the halfback receives it already moving sideways at the sideline landmark, never slowing his momentum.

beats.title: 3. The Force Player Is Kicked Out
beats.text: The wrapping guard arrives at the force corner and drives him inside. The entire defensive edge collapses inward while the sweep lane stays wide.

beats.title: 4. The Downfield Escort
beats.text: With the force kicked out and the alley blocked, the halfback turns upfield behind three escorts — including a flanker who has crossed the formation to stalk the last pursuer.

relations.tell: Two linemen leave the line of scrimmage immediately in opposite directions — no Lombardi companion play shows this picture.
